title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Building a Budget That Fits Your Real Life

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a step in building a monthly budget as described in the narration?
options: List all sources of monthly income
questions.explanation: The narration outlines the steps as: list income, list fixed bills, track variable expenses, allocate priorities and savings, then calculate and adjust. Calculating net worth is not part of the budgeting process described.

questions.text: True or false: If your total expenses are greater than your total income, you have a surplus that can be redirected to savings.
questions.explanation: The narration states that when expenses exceed income (a negative result), you need to adjust spending or find extra income; a surplus occurs only when income exceeds expenses.
